streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream A contains substrate and solvent. Flow rate calculated to achieve total Q of 0.5 mL/min with Stream B.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream B contains oxidant. Concentration set to 1.2 equiv relative to Alkene. Flow rate calculated to maintain stoichiometry.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: All components combined simultaneously. Static mixer recommended due to Da > 1 (mixing limitation) identified in engineering calculations.
pre_reactor_steps: Sparging with Nitrogen for 10 minutes to remove dissolved oxygen, as reaction is oxygen-sensitive (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: In-line magnetic filtration or quenching into aqueous workup to separate magnetic Pd catalyst particles.
chemistry_notes: Reaction is a Pd-catalyzed alkene dioxygenation using PhI(OAc)2. Heterogeneous catalyst (magnetic Pd) requires solid-liquid separation. Oxygen sensitivity necessitates N2 sparging. Engineering calculations indicate Da > 1, suggesting mixing limitations; static mixer used to enhance mixing. No photochemistry involved. Thermal conditions are mild (20 C).
